in_sanskrit.name: भवी
in_sanskrit.meaning: Bhāvī, भवन (to be, to exist, to create)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who creates, exists, or causes to be. A name that signifies the divine power of creation and existence. It is derived from the Sanskrit root भव (bhaava), which means 'to be', 'to exist', 'to create'. The suffix -ी (ī) is added to form a feminine or diminutive form. The name Bhāvī signifies the divine feminine aspect of creation and existence.
